(AMS) is seeking a talented Test Instrumentation System Administrator to join our diverse team, in the IFMC Field Office, WSMR, New Mexico., to create unique solutions for complex problems. Assets consist of server/switch-based suites with simulation software used to stimulate equipment under test during test event. Experience using TIS tools such as defense planning/engagement simulators, data collection/storage, and the White Sands Missile Range (WSMR) Local Area Networks (LAN) is desired. Applicants should have experience with coordinating daily instrumentation and simulation work station tasks, network administrative activities, and have the expertise to lead troubleshooting efforts throughout the Test network. Candidate will be required to perform Cyber-Security scanning along with implementing patch and STIG requirements. Coordination with Army Project Office personnel and test range agencies for equipment support and status is also required. Candidate must be willing to travel between various DoD test ranges to attend test planning meetings and system integration/testing events and must be able to work in a high paced environment with flexible work schedule during test execution phases. Candidate must be self-motivated and possess good communication and team working skills to coordinate multiple test support activities with various DoD Agencies. Responsibilities Configure, operate, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot TIS and Army developmental tactical system assets. Administer Linux and Microsoft Windows operating systems in a test environment. Coordinate daily instrumentation and simulation workstation activities and network administration tasks. Lead troubleshooting efforts across test networks, systems, and supporting infrastructure. Perform cybersecurity vulnerability scanning and implement required patches and Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) requirements. Support test instrumentation, simulation, data collection, storage, and related system activities. Coordinate equipment support, system status, and technical requirements with Army Project Office personnel, test range agencies, and other DoD organizations. Support system integration, test planning, test execution, and post-test activities at DoD test ranges and facilities. Develop, troubleshoot, and maintain scripts supporting system administration, test operations, and network activities. Provide technical advice and timely status updates to stakeholders supporting multiple concurrent test activities. Required Experience Required Qualifications U.S. citizenship. Current Secret security clearance and ability to maintain eligibility for access. Technical degree or equivalent relevant experience. Minimum of three years of technical experience supporting information technology systems on DoD programs involving test and tactical systems instrumentation and simulation. Extensive knowledge of Test Instrumentation and Simulation (TIS) assets. Information management and cybersecurity experience supporting Army Integrated Air and Missile Defense (AIAMD) systems, including PATRIOT and Integrated Battle Command System (IBCS). Demonstrated expertise administering Linux and Microsoft Windows operating systems. An approved IT baseline certification, such as CompTIA Security+ CE or higher, at time of hire; candidates who do not currently possess Security+ CE must obtain the certification within 120 days of hire. Ability to work independently, communicate effectively, and collaborate with personnel across multiple DoD agencies and organizations. Preferred Qualifications CompTIA Network+ or Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification. Linux and Microsoft operating system certifications, such as Linux+, Microsoft Technology Associate (MTA), or higher. Demonstrated knowledge of DoD and Army information technology security policies, procedures, and IT administrator practices. Experience supporting DoD secure data network accreditation and certification processes and procedures. Experience using TIS tools, including defense planning and engagement simulators, data collection and storage systems, and WSMR local area networks. Prior experience supporting systems integration and test activities at DoD test ranges and facilities. Working knowledge of one or more scripting languages, with the ability to develop new scripts and troubleshoot existing scripts. Experience supporting cybersecurity compliance activities, including vulnerability scanning, patch management, and STIG implementation. review_candidates.description: Middleware Platform, Azure, Microsoft Windows Server, Monitoring, Automation and AI Location: Remote — Pune or Baroda Experience: 4–6 years Shift: 24×7 rotation, including planned maintenance windows and change events Role Summary You will keep our Middleware Platform, Azure and Windows server estate running day to day — responding to alerts, resolving incidents within SLA, Product/Application deployment, executing changes cleanly, and steadily improving the stability of the systems in your care. You work within established processes and alongside Team Engineers and Database Administrators, taking ownership of your own queue and escalating appropriately. This role also carries a real automation mandate. We expect you to notice repetitive manual work and remove it — through scripting, through Azure automation tooling, and increasingly through AI agents that handle routine operational tasks. Experience 4–6 years in systems administration, Application and infrastructure support or cloud operations. Minimum 4 years hands-on production Azure administration (not lab, training or certification-only exposure). Minimum 3 years administering Windows Server in production. Experience working to SLAs in a ticket-driven support environment. Willing and available to work rotating 24×7 shifts and out-of-hours maintenance windows. Preferred Qualifications Graduation or Above Healthcare or other regulated-industry experience. Key Responsibilities Azure platform administration Administer Azure infrastructure day to day; provision, resize and decommission Azure resources following documented standards and approved change requests. Support Azure PaaS workloads including App Services — deployments, configuration, scaling and restarts. Apply resource tagging, cost-optimisation recommendations and policy compliance actions as directed. Alert monitoring and response Own the alert queue on your shift. Monitor Logic Monitor, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and the enterprise monitoring platform; acknowledge, triage and action alerts within SLA. Investigate alerts using KQL queries in Log Analytics, Application Insights telemetry and Windows Event Logs. Identify duplicate or non-actionable alerts and propose tuning — threshold changes, aggregation windows, suppression rules. Flagging a bad alert is part of the job, not an optional extra. Maintain monitoring coverage and visibility: report agents that are down or resources missing from monitoring, and build/maintain dashboards and workbooks that surface system health to the team. System stabilisation Resolve incidents end to end; support the Team Members during major incidents with diagnostics, evidence gathering and communication updates. Contribute to root cause analysis — collect logs and timelines, document findings, and implement the corrective actions assigned to you. Perform proactive health checks across applications, servers and Azure resources: disk, CPU, memory, service state, certificate expiry, backup success. Build knowledge of application architecture, help create and update application and alert-handling documentation, and perform pre/post product functionality checks. Track recurring issues in your queue and raise them as problem records rather than repeatedly applying the same workaround. Perform performance troubleshooting using standard OS and Azure diagnostic tools. AI agent development and process automation Write and maintain PowerShell scripts for routine administration: user and resource provisioning, health checks, reporting, scheduled tasks and cleanup jobs. Optional: Build automation using Azure Automation Runbooks, Logic Apps and Power Automate, with proper authentication via managed identity and alerting on failure. Contribute to building AI agents that support operations — log summarisation, alert triage and classification, drafting incident notes, and answering questions from our runbook and knowledge base. Apply prompt engineering to generate scripts, configurations and documentation, and verify AI output before it reaches production — you are accountable for what you deploy, regardless of what produced it. Follow responsible-AI practice without exception. Windows and application support Administer Windows Server in Azure and hybrid environments Support IIS — application pool management, bindings, virtual directories, logs and basic performance troubleshooting. Perform SSL/TLS certificate tasks: renewal, installation, binding, store management and expiry monitoring. Support high-availability configurations including Windows Failover Clustering and SQL Server Always On, working with the team engineers and the database administrators. Process and collaboration Work within ITIL incident, problem and change management using ServiceNow; raise and document change requests accurately and complete them within approved windows. Maintain and improve runbooks, SOPs and knowledge articles — especially after resolving something the documentation didn't cover. Provide clear, timely shift handovers and status updates to stakeholders during incidents. Communication Clear written and spoken English; able to write an incident update a non-technical stakeholder can follow. Reliable, organised, and comfortable asking for help early rather than late. Technical Azure PaaS and IaaS administration, Windows Server administration, IIS administration and SSL certificate handling. Azure Monitor and Log Analytics, with working ability to read and write basic KQL. PowerShell scripting — able to write and modify scripts independently, not only run existing ones. Ticketing and ITIL process discipline. Practical use of AI/LLM tools in a work context, with at least one concrete example of manual work you've automated or removed. Certifications Required: AZ-104 (Azure Administrator Associate) — held, not "training completed". Preferred: AZ-900, AI-900, ITIL Foundation, MCSA or equivalent Windows Server certification.

Mail and connectivity: Troubleshoot Exchange, mobility, and connectivity issues, including those raised by monitoring alerts. Joiners, movers, and leavers: Set up and retire accounts, devices, and access so every new starter is productive on day one. Policies and risk: Keep security policies current, maintain the risk register, and report risk status to leadership. Customer assurance: Help answer customer security questionnaires and due diligence requests. Process improvement: Spot manual IT and compliance tasks worth automating and put the fix in place. Working knowledge of networking, including IP, DNS, and SMTP. Experience supporting audits or controls under ISO 27001, SOC 2, or a similar framework. Comfortable using AI tools to speed up documentation, triage, and analysis. High attention to detail, with the discipline to keep evidence clean and current. Explains technical and control topics clearly to non-technical colleagues and auditors. Comfortable in a scaling environment where problems often arrive without a clear owner. Nice to haves: Experience with Intune or other mobile device management platforms. Familiarity with Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Purview. PowerShell scripting for automation and reporting. A relevant certification, such as Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer. Experience in LegalTech or other professional-services software environments. Life at Nexl Hybrid working. You'll be in our Sydney hub 1-2 days a week for collaboration. Work from anywhere. Spend up to four weeks a year working from outside Australia. Purposeful connection. A jam-packed social scene with weekly catered lunch, quarterly socials, team off-sites, and events throughout the year to bring everyone together. Birthday leave. review_candidates.description: Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better. Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place. Role Description Form Energy's IT Engineering & Platforms team owns the tools, platforms, and identity infrastructure that the whole company runs on — Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra, Atlassian, Google Workspace, Slack, and the integration layers connecting them to name a few. As Senior Microsoft 365 & Azure Engineer, you will take deep technical ownership of our Microsoft ecosystem. This role picks up and grows a substantial body of existing work — Intune deployment, Autopilot rollout, Azure entitlement management, and device/BYOD governance — and takes it further as Form Energy scales. This is a hybrid role, which will require working onsite from our office in Somerville, MA 3+ days per week. Relocation assistance is available. What You'll Do Own and evolve our Microsoft Intune environment: policy design, compliance baselines, app deployment, and troubleshooting across a growing device fleet. Lead ongoing Windows Autopilot operations and improvements — provisioning profiles, enrollment experience, and zero-touch deployment at scale. Manage and expand our Azure Entra entitlement program, including access reviews, conditional access policy, and identity governance as the company grows. Own SharePoint architecture and governance — site/hub structure, permissions models, information architecture, and lifecycle management as SharePoint scales as a core collaboration platform. Develop and maintain BYOD and device policy frameworks, including work with external consulting companies and contractors. Write and maintain technical playbooks and runbooks for the M365/Azure ecosystem so operational knowledge is documented and repeatable, not tribal. Design and implement automation using Microsoft Graph API and Power Automate to reduce manual toil across identity, device management, SharePoint provisioning, and M365 administration. Partner with the Risk & Cybersecurity vertical on shared concerns (device compliance, conditional access, identity security) while maintaining clear operational ownership on the Engineering & Platforms side. Serve as the platform-level escalation point for complex identity, device, or M365 configuration issues that go beyond day-to-day support (day-to-day support, break/fix, and ticket resolution remain owned by IT Operations). Evaluate new Microsoft ecosystem capabilities (e.g., Copilot, Intune Suite features) and recommend adoption paths. Contribute to the team's platform inventory, documentation, and knowledge base as we formalize operating processes. Participate in Incident Response activities as needed. What You'll Bring 5+ years in a Microsoft 365/Azure engineering or systems administration role, with real depth (not just admin-console familiarity). Hands-on production experience with Intune — policy authoring, app deployment, troubleshooting at scale. Direct experience implementing or operating Windows Autopilot. Working knowledge of Azure Entra ID (Azure AD) — entitlement management, conditional access, access reviews. Strong hands-on SharePoint management experience — site architecture, permissions/governance, hub sites, and information architecture at an organizational scale. Experience developing device/security policy for hybrid environments, including contractor or third-party device scenarios (BYOD). Strong scripting/automation skills, with demonstrated Microsoft Graph API experience for automating identity, device, and M365 workflows. Hands-on experience building and maintaining Power Automate flows for business process automation across M365/Azure. Track record of writing clear technical documentation — playbooks, runbooks, SOPs. Comfortable operating with autonomy and moving quickly; able to design a solution and implement it. Experience collaborating across security/risk and engineering boundaries without conflating the two. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Microsoft Copilot deployment or AI governance in a Microsoft ecosystem. Familiarity with Google Workspace or multi-IdP environments (useful context for Form Energy's hybrid M365/Google setup). Exposure to manufacturing, hardware, or engineering-heavy companies where IT supports both corporate and plant/lab environments. Experience with SCIM provisioning or identity sync across platforms (e.g., Slack, Atlassian). Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs. If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion. Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process. Compensation Range: $128,662 - $160,807
